name: Nonna — Back Office
description: The back office: the shift roster, absence requests with cover worked out before anyone decides, requisitions ruled on by budget and authority, and the invoice ledger — rendered as Nonna's living desk inside Copilot.

conversation_starters.title: A day off
conversation_starters.text: Maria wants Friday dinner off — who could cover, and what happens if I approve it?

conversation_starters.title: Waiting for a signature
conversation_starters.text: Which requisitions need my approval, and why did each one land on my desk?

conversation_starters.title: The budget
conversation_starters.text: How much of this month's supplies budget is left?
